tools.name: metrics_discover
tools.description: List the metrics present in this workspace, with each metric's type, unit, description and the attribute keys and values seen on it. Takes no arguments. A listing above 150,000 characters is returned without its attribute values, or without its attributes, and the response names what was omitted.

tools.name: alerts_list
tools.description: Kopai alert events (FIRING and RESOLVED), newest first. Each row has event_id, rule_id, rule_name, transition, at, observed and threshold ({value, unit, text}; quote `text`), incident_url and delivery_status (did the Slack message go out). `truncated` is true when more events matched than `limit`. Use alert_get with an event_id for the full event and the query that fired.

changed_since.description: Only events written at or after this time, ordered by when they were written. When polling, pass the previous poll's time minus 2 minutes and skip event_ids already handled.

limit.description: How many to return, at most 200.

state.description: Which transitions to list: FIRING events, RESOLVED events, or both. Not whether an alert is still open.

tools.name: alert_get
tools.description: One alert event in full, by event_id: the event, the event it pairs with (the RESOLVED that closed a FIRING, or the FIRING a RESOLVED closed), the rule as it is now, the query that produced the value (run it with the `query` tool, widened and bucketed, to see the series), and the Slack delivery. Adds observed, threshold and incident_url.

event_id.description: The event's id, from alerts_list or the incident link (.../incidents/<event_id>).

tools.name: alert_history
tools.description: One rule's alert events, newest first, in the alerts_list row shape: has this happened before? `since` keeps events at or after a time.

limit.description: How many to return, at most 200.

rule_id.description: The rule's id, from alert_rules_list or an alert.

since.description: Only events at or after this time.

tools.name: alert_rules_list
tools.description: The workspace's alert rules, by name, each with its live state (OK, PENDING or FIRING, and since when), lastEvaluatedAt, lastError and editor_url. `metric_name` keeps the rules on one metric; check it before alert_rule_create to avoid a duplicate. Read a rule here before alert_rule_update. `unreadable` lists rules this version cannot read.

limit.description: How many to return, at most 200.

metric_name.description: Only the rules on this metric: the exact check for a duplicate before alert_rule_create.

tools.name: alert_rule_backtest
tools.description: An estimate of how often a draft rule would have fired over the last 24h or 7d, with each firing's start and end; not a replay of real evaluations. Takes the rule's measurement and firing fields (no name). The range is shortened to what one query can cover and to the workspace's retention: `from` and `to` are the range covered, `range` the one asked for.
